title: Tray Mod
description: Minimize Minecraft to the system tray with one keypress while keeping the game running quietly in the background.
body:
**Tray Mod** lets you instantly minimize Minecraft to the Windows system tray with a single keypress, keeping your world running smoothly in the background without cluttering your taskbar. It’s perfect for AFKing, multitasking, or playing on a single monitor - your game continues running normally while the window is hidden and sounds are temporarily paused.

The mod includes a tray icon with click‑to‑restore support and a clean keybinding (default: **M**) for quick toggling.
Built for stability and simplicity, Tray Mod requires **Fabric API** (tested on **0.141.3+1.21.11**) and runs on **Minecraft 1.21.11** with **Fabric Loader 0.18.4**.

Whether you're AFK farming, switching between tasks, or just want Minecraft out of the way without closing it, **Tray Mod makes the game run in the background for you.**
